name: voice
description: Let the agent say short lines aloud through the speakers — status, a nudge for attention, or a one-line spoken summary. Uses macOS `say` today, with a clean path to vocli for real cross-platform TTS.

interface.shortDescription: The agent speaks short lines aloud (macOS say, then vocli).
interface.longDescription: An agent skill for deliberate spoken output: short, self-contained lines the user hears through the speakers. Ships a speak.sh wrapper using macOS say, designed to swap to vocli for real cross-platform text-to-speech later.
